estimand: Whether Hangzhou source discharge measured at Jinan's native acceleration contributes to predicting second-straight-car stop-line entry by t+10 inclusive under the frozen high signal request in repaired Jinan. The prediction study precedes any action or policy comparison.
target_registry_identity: Use only the original 24 Jinan right/straight pair identities verified in ../tsc_jinan_left_geometry_20261107/source_reuse.json. Rebind physical lanes, signals and request indices to the passed geometry candidate.
target_selection: Recompute the four development PP hours on the repaired target at ten-second cadence. Use the six points, eight feasible choices, nominal high/low straight exposure 4/0 and two initially stopped straight leaders. Select by the prior deterministic lexicographic point, then time and physical movement order with no repeated time or continuous both-supplied visit. Save checkpoints and ordered vehicle IDs. Require all 24 cells and freeze this target roster alongside the 12 stored Hangzhou checkpoints before opening any branch outcomes. Stop on inadequate coverage or unsafe/incomplete acquisition.
measurement: Each of the 12 Hangzhou starts gets the identical high request twice: both tracked cars at the native 2.6 m/s², and with only their nominal accel set to 2.0 m/s². Each of the 24 Jinan starts gets one high request at native 2.0 m/s². Verify the archived preaction snapshot, including vehicle IDs, rank, parameters and feasible request, before each branch. Preserve physical signals and actual exposure through second 10, including clearance extensions; read second-car stop-line entry with the same native event rule. Stop on irreproducible, unsafe or incomplete measurements. Use all frozen cases.
frozen_forecast_rule: Recalculate stratum-specific native target T, target-aligned source A and native source H plus case-pooled T_pool and A_pool only from these development arms. Freeze (T+A)/2 and all five controls: T, T_pool, (T+T_pool)/2, (T+A_pool)/2, (T+H)/2. No tuning or refitting on test outcomes.

later_independent_prediction.scope: Separate stage after successful development and numerical forecast freeze. Use repaired Jinan, the same 24 physical measurement identities and all six strata per seed; freeze the full target roster before opening its 24 native high-arm outcomes. Retain a safety or coverage stop without replacements. Report per-seed and overall Brier loss with equal point then seed weights. Continue to a new action-contrast study only if the candidate strictly beats every overall control and beats the matched pure-target average (T+T_pool)/2 on at least 3/4 seeds.
